components.name: Winlator Bionic Android orchestration reference
components.license: MIT (repository license; audit bundled assets separately)
components.role: Android process orchestration for standard Box64/Box86 Wine containers and Arm64EC FEXCore/WowBox64 containers

components.name: Wine
components.role: Windows PE/DLL loader and Windows API compatibility

components.name: Box64
components.role: x86-64 Linux user-space dynamic translation for standard Wine containers

components.name: Box86
components.role: optional 32-bit x86 Linux user-space emulator for compatible Wine configurations

components.name: FEXCore
components.role: alternate x86-64/32-bit execution backend in supported Arm64EC Wine/Proton containers

alternative_backend.role: alternative ARM64 Wine emulator-DLL approach; retain only if it passes separate Android and plug-in ABI tests

memory_policy.allocation_policy: No fixed application-level RAM budget; allocations are governed by available OS/device memory and driver limits

required_before_apk_distribution: reproducible ARM64 Android build of the selected Wine and emulator components
corresponding source and license notices for all LGPL/GPL components
AE SDK ABI host coverage report
independent backend smoke tests: Box64 x86_64, Box86/WoW64 x86, FEXCore Arm64EC containers
PE architecture routing tests including x86-64, x86, ARM64EC and ARM64X test fixtures
separate Wine prefixes for different emulator backends; do not mix incompatible emulator DLL sets
build and run the aexlo Windows x64 worker under both Wine+Box64 and Arm64EC Wine+FEXCore container variants
test sample AEX plug-ins from real x86-64 Windows distributions and compare output/parameters against After Effects references
implement or explicitly report missing AEGP, sequence, mask, text, camera, composite and GPU host features
supervise one isolated worker process per native plug-in and verify crash/timeout recovery
test Android rootfs extraction and direct guest process launching without root on OPPO/Qualcomm and Huawei/Mali-class devices
test QEMU x86_64 Linux-user Wine fallback against the same PE host worker used by Box64
test clvk OpenCL path only through a real Wine OpenCL ICD bridge and representative plug-in kernels; report unsupported OpenCL extensions
run LIEF independently against the Rust PE importer and compare machine/import/export results
use Qiling only in a development analysis harness to trace Windows API calls; do not ship it in the APK by default
keep no application-level memory limits in all runtime backends
explicit_non_claims: No claim that arbitrary Windows EXE/DLL files already run inside EffectCraft
No claim that arbitrary AE AEX plug-ins are fully hosted
No claim that all AE SmartFX or AEGP suites are implemented
No claim of unlimited physical memory or GPU resources

candidates: Arm64EC Wine/Proton + FEXCore or WowBox64 where configured
Arm64EC Wine/Proton container; verify PE and imported ABI before selection
Manual compatibility review; do not assume ARM64EC compatibility
Native ARM64 runtime if the host/plugin ABI is actually ARM64

ae_plugin_host.name: aexlo
ae_plugin_host.role: Windows x64 After Effects Effect API host shim; run as an isolated PE worker inside Wine/Box64 or Arm64EC Wine/FEXCore
ae_plugin_host.upstream_status: heavy development; incomplete suites and features remain
ae_plugin_host.platform_note: upstream targets Windows x64 and macOS arm64; Windows x64 worker must run under the Android Windows compatibility container

alternative_backends.role: Third execution fallback for x86-64 Linux Wine binaries on Android ARM64; it translates Linux ELF execution, not Windows PE directly
limitations: requires a compatible x86-64 Wine/glibc rootfs
slower than dynarec backends in expected workloads
must bundle and audit runtime shared-library dependencies

alternative_backends.role: Optional Android ARM64 OpenCL 3.0 implementation layered on Vulkan, for plug-ins whose OpenCL usage can be bridged through Wine
limitations: compiler-disabled build supports only precompiled SPIR-V paths
full runtime OpenCL C compilation needs clspv/LLVM
Wine OpenCL ICD bridge to Android ARM64 driver is unverified

alternative_backends.role: Development-only PE/API emulation and dynamic instrumentation to identify imported Windows APIs and missing host shims
limitations: Python tooling, not suitable as the main frame-rendering runtime
not an AE host; still needs AE SDK suite shims
keep outside shipping APK unless GPL and size implications are intentionally accepted

alternative_backends.role: Independent robust PE/COFF parser for validating imports, exports, sections, symbols and machine architecture
limitations: analysis/parsing only; does not execute Windows code or provide Windows APIs

rootfs_strategy.method: Extract a verified compressed Wine/glibc rootfs into EffectCraft's private files directory; launch Box64 directly with explicit LD_LIBRARY_PATH and BOX64_LD_LIBRARY_PATH, following Winlator's Android RootFS and GuestProgramLauncher pattern

proot_optional.role: Optional path redirection and chroot-like rootfs view where the direct launcher is insufficient

rootfs_manager.role: Reference for rootfs bootstrap, architecture selection and QEMU user-mode handling

graphics_backends.role: OpenGL compatibility through selected Mesa driver path (Zink/Turnip/VirGL where supported)
OpenCL 3.0 on Vulkan for compatible OpenCL plug-ins
graphics_backends.status: experimental; Wine bridge and runtime compiler need verification
not currently solved for ordinary Android GPUs
